roadmap.title: Plan the campaign run around the missable restrictions
roadmap.description: Play in Relaxed Mode and research only Wood Engines until the final Radioactive Waste delivery. During normal missions, use a wingless ground vehicle for Cargo truck, Wingless and Airship, and a two-goods request for Two Birds, One Flight.

roadmap.title: Finish the remaining missions and free-flight goals
roadmap.description: After the campaign, research rocket engines for the Speed achievements and build a balloon plane for Edge of space. Then finish every remaining airport mission, including the prison island, SOS camp and helipad ships.

achievements.description: Make a delivery without leaving the ground
achievements.sortReason: Missable once every mission is done; combine with Wingless and Airship.
achievements.summary: Deliver a mission's cargo without leaving the ground.

guide.context: The delivery must belong to a mission, so this cannot be earned once every mission is completed.

steps.text: Go to the Desert Island.
steps.note: Its terrain is flat and its ground routes are long.

steps.text: Build a ground vehicle with about 8 Wood Engines, stacked cockpits, large Retractable Gears, and many fuel tanks.
Load Titanium at the Mine.
Drive the whole route to the Waste Storage.
steps.note: Small hops do not count as flying. Large hills block Wood Engines.

steps.text: Deliver the Titanium at the Waste Storage.
Complete the Weather Station campaign mission on the starting island.
steps.note: Side missions are not required, but they give money and scrap.

steps.text: Complete the Research Facility campaign mission on the Snow Island.
Continue to the Explosion Site and Waste Storage campaign missions on the Desert Island.
Drop off the Radioactive Waste at the Waste Storage.

achievements.description: Finish the campaign with wood engines only
achievements.sortReason: Set up at the start of the run; unlocks with Campaign.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign using only Wood Engines.

guide.context: Researching any other engine type voids this for the whole run. Using one voids it too. Cockpits, fuel tanks, wings, landing gear and other non-engine parts are safe to research. The small jet wing is a wing, not an engine.

steps.text: Play the campaign in Relaxed Mode.
steps.note: Relaxed Mode makes timed deliveries easier.

steps.text: Build every plane with Wood Engines.
Stack the Wood Engines into each other to cut drag.
Put balloons in the body of the plane to carry heavy cargo at low speed.
Build a very heavy plane for the final delivery.
steps.note: One build used 14 to 20 Wood Engines.

steps.text: Drop off the Radioactive Waste at the Waste Storage on the Desert Island.

achievements.description: Complete a mission with a plane that has no wings
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Cargo truck and Airship.
achievements.summary: Complete a mission using a plane with no wings.

guide.context: Tail wings count as wings. The plane must complete a mission, so this cannot be earned once every mission is completed.

steps.text: Build a ground vehicle with no wings.
steps.note: A flying option is balloons on the sides with engines pointing upward.

steps.text: Land at an airport to receive a mission.
Deliver the mission's cargo with the wingless vehicle.
steps.note: Driving the whole way at a speed of 50 or less also counts for Cargo truck and Airship.

achievements.description: Complete 2 missions using only a single takeoff and landing.
achievements.sortReason: Earned naturally on the Hermit fish and crab request.
achievements.summary: Complete 2 missions with a single takeoff and landing.

guide.context: Each good in an airport request is its own mission. A mission completes when its last required item is delivered. This only unlocks during an active delivery mission, so it cannot be earned in free play after the campaign.

steps.text: Land at Hermit, the small island between the Snow Island and the Desert Island.
Take the Hermit request for 8 fish and 8 crabs.
Deliver 3 fish and 3 crabs on each of the first two flights.
Carry the last 2 fish and 2 crabs together on the third flight.
steps.note: Both missions must finish on this one takeoff and landing.

achievements.description: Complete every mission in the campaign
achievements.sortReason: Needs every airport, including prison and helipad ships.
achievements.summary: Complete every mission from every airport.

guide.context: Cargo truck, Wingless, Airship and Two Birds, One Flight each need a mission to complete. None of them can be earned once every mission is finished.

steps.text: Hover over each airport on the map to see whether missions remain there.
Land at each airport that still has missions.
steps.note: An airport gives out a mission only after you land there.

steps.text: Finish the missions at the two airports on the starting island, in the west and the centre.
Finish the missions at both airports beside the wrecked ship in the south.
Finish the missions at the SOS camp on the Snow Island's northwest side.
Finish the missions at Hermit, the small island between the Snow Island and the Desert Island.
Finish the missions on the prison island near the starting island.
Build a helicopter for the four ship helipad missions.
Fly the helicopter to WaveRider, west of the Snow Island.
Hover near the ship until the radio confirms the delivery.
Set down on the ship and pick up the reward.
Make the same helipad delivery on IronSail, north of the Snow Island near the Factory.
Make the same helipad delivery on DawnBreaker, east of the Snow Island.
Make the same helipad delivery on OilTanker, west of the Desert Island.

achievements.description: Complete a mission without exceeding a speed of 50 between takeoff and landing
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Cargo truck and Wingless.
achievements.summary: Complete a mission without going faster than 50.

guide.context: The speed limit applies from takeoff to landing. This needs a mission to complete, so it cannot be earned once every mission is completed.

steps.text: Build a slow ground vehicle.
Land at an airport to receive a mission.
Drive the mission's cargo to its destination at a speed of 50 or less.
steps.note: The same delivery can count for Wingless and Cargo truck.

achievements.sortReason: Same rocket flight as Speed 2 and 3.

guide.context: Rocket engines are not Wood Engines. Researching them before the campaign ends voids the Wood engine achievement.

steps.text: Build a plane with an elongated cockpit, one Retractable Gear, and 6 to 7 rocket engines at the rear.
Fill the remaining space with big external fuel tanks.
Take off and pull up slightly.
Retract the gear.
Hold full throttle until the speed passes 500.
steps.note: This build passed 4000, so one flight can also earn Speed 2 and Speed 3.

achievements.sortReason: Same rocket flight as Speed 1 and 3.

guide.context: Rocket engines are not Wood Engines. Researching them before the campaign ends voids the Wood engine achievement.

steps.text: Build a plane with an elongated cockpit, one Retractable Gear, and 6 to 7 rocket engines at the rear.
Fill the remaining space with big external fuel tanks.
Take off and pull up slightly.
Retract the gear.
Hold full throttle until the speed passes 1000.
steps.note: This build passed 4000, so one flight can also earn Speed 1 and Speed 3.

achievements.sortReason: Same rocket flight as Speed 1 and 2.

guide.context: Rocket engines are not Wood Engines. Researching them before the campaign ends voids the Wood engine achievement.

steps.text: Build a plane with an elongated cockpit, one Retractable Gear, and 6 to 7 rocket engines at the rear.
Fill the remaining space with big external fuel tanks.
Take off and pull up slightly.
Retract the gear.
Hold full throttle until the speed passes 3000.
steps.note: This build passed 4000, so one flight can also earn Speed 1 and Speed 2.

achievements.sortReason: Balloon plane, about 2 minutes of climbing.

steps.text: Build a plane with a single fuselage.
Attach as many balloons as you can.
steps.note: One build used about 40,000 coins of balloons.

steps.text: Take off and wait about 2 minutes.
Turn the camera down with right-click to check your height.
steps.note: The region and distance appear below the plane.
